description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Maine Revised Statutes — Maine state law — by citation. "17-A M.R.S. 201" is murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Maine Title 17-A section 201 say" or to check a Maine statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section within the title, e.g. "201" (murder) or "2411" (OUI).

name: me_revised_statute
title: Me Revised Statute
